evidence: Sentiment experienced a severe contraction on 2018-11-15, plunging 21 points from a neutral 49 to 28 ('Fear'). This sharp deterioration highlights acute market stress and capitulation following a multi-week consolidation near the 50 mark. While extreme sentiment readings can occasionally foreshadow contrarian mean-reversion, sudden multi-standard-deviation drops in the Fear & Greed Index typically accompany structural momentum breakdowns where immediate follow-through downside risk predominates over the subsequent 24 hours. Consequently, the probability of an upward move is moderately suppressed below even odds.
limitations: The Fear & Greed Index is a lagging composite indicator reflecting prior-day market conditions.
Short 24-hour forecast horizons can be dominated by liquidity dynamics not fully captured by sentiment indexes alone.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
